title: Section-normalized finite compact-support evaluation
statement: Fix a whole-system coefficient model family $D$ of [def-sp-field-shriek-system-models], $E$ in its coefficient-field index, and a compactification $X\xrightarrow j Z\xrightarrow hY$. Use the ring and support evaluation of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels] at level $n+1$, and the finite compact-support functor of [det-sp-reduction-direct-image], as defined in [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison]. A finite support coordinate datum is an ordinary natural isomorphism from the recorded constant-ring proper pushforward to the ringed-site direct image with its specified constant-ring comparison, whose maps are identity on every section. Define support evaluation as the composite of the recorded $Rf_!$ system evaluation isomorphism and the right-derived functor of this ordinary section-identity isomorphism, whiskered after the finite open extension. This is a normalization datum and a real construction, with no existence assertion.
